metadata.description: Open-source Polish anti-slop writing tools for Claude and Claude Code.

plugins.name: stop-slop-pl
plugins.description: Polish-language anti-slop writing skill. Makes minimal edits to AI-sounding, bureaucratic, generic, or translated Polish while preserving facts, register, and voice. Triggers on popraw styl, napisz po ludzku, uprość, usuń slop, and similar requests.
